name: MXR M102 Dyna Comp (CA3080, script era)
description: MXR Dyna Comp, original CA3080 circuit on a 9 V battery (no supply or bias decoupling caps, as on the original board). Vb ≈ 2.9 V from a 56 kΩ / 27 kΩ divider. Input: C1 10 nF, R1 10 kΩ into the Q1 2N3904 emitter follower (R2 1 MΩ from Vb, R3 10 kΩ emitter), C2 1 µF to the OTA inverting input (R4 1 MΩ to ground). The non-inverting input is fed from the inverting one through the 2 kΩ balance trimmer, whose wiper takes the OTA input bias from +9 V through R5 470 kΩ; R6 1 MΩ to ground and the R7 15 kΩ ∥ C4 10 nF + C3 1 µF leg make the + input a frequency-dependent fraction of the − input, so the OTA amplifies a small, treble-weighted difference (pre-emphasis). CA3080 output into R8 150 kΩ ∥ C5 1 nF to Vb, driving the Q2 phase splitter (R9 / R10 10 kΩ). Both phases are coupled through C6 / C7 10 nF onto R11 / R12 1 MΩ with D1 / D2 1N914 clamps at the bases of Q3 / Q4, which discharge C8 10 µF against R13 150 kΩ from +9 V. Q5 follows C8 and feeds the OTA's IABC pin through the 500 kΩ Sensitivity rheostat and R17 27 kΩ: the gain-control loop runs entirely in the circuit. Output from Q2's emitter through C9 50 nF, R14 10 kΩ and the 50 kΩ Output pot.

sources.title: ElectroSmash, 'MXR Dyna Comp Analysis' (archive mirror): schematic and BOM (C1 0.01µF; C2, C3 1µF; C4, C6, C7 10nF; C5 1nF; C8 10µF; C9 50nF; Q1-Q5 2N3904; D1, D2 1N914; RV1 500K; RV2 50K; trimmer 2K; R1, R3, R9, R10, R14 10K; R2, R4, R6, R11, R12 1M; R5 470K; R7 15K; R8, R13 150K; R17 27K; R15 56K; R16 22K; U1 CA3080), 'the original design did not include decoupling caps in the power supply', D3 reverse-polarity diode, input / OTA / envelope / output analysis

R. G. Keen, 'D-Comp and R-Comp Compressors' (GeoFex, 1999-2001): Dyna Comp workalike schematic and parts list; Vb divider 56K / 27K, OTA load 150K ∥ 0.01µF, Sustain 500K lin, Level 50K log; supply and Vb caps marked 'not in the original'; circuit description of the rectifier, Q5 and the gain loop

O. Kröning, K. Dempwolf, U. Zölzer, 'Analysis and simulation of an analog guitar compressor', DAFx-11: component table (R9 56k / R10 27k supply divider, Vbias = 2.93 V, OTA roll-off R8 150k / C4 1 nF, P 2 kΩ, RS 470 kΩ sensitivity, RV 47 kΩ volume), IABC law (eq. 22), measured static curves (Fig. 6) and dynamic envelopes (Fig. 5)
Intersil CA3080/CA3080A datasheet FN475.5: pinout (2 −, 3 +, 4 V−, 5 IABC, 6 output, 7 V+), gm 9.6 mS at IABC 500 µA, amplifier bias voltage 0.71 V, input resistance 26 kΩ, input bias current 2 µA
Intersil application note AN6668 (Wittlinger): gm = 19.2·IABC (mS, mA)
Freestompboxes, 'MXR Dyna Comp' thread: redrawn 1977-78 factory schematic, version notes (some units with MPSA14 / LM13700 and 470 kΩ C-taper sensitivity / 10 kΩ A-taper volume pots)

controls.label: Output
controls.note: RV2 50 kΩ audio-taper output pot (Keen: 50K log; K11's unit 47 kΩ; some later units 10 kΩ A)

controls.label: Sensitivity
controls.note: RV1 500 kΩ rheostat in series with R17 27 kΩ between Q5's emitter and the CA3080 IABC pin: clockwise = less resistance = more IABC = more gain and sustain. Legacy 'Sustain'

controls.label: Attack
controls.note: No attack control on the Dyna Comp: attack is set by Q3/Q4 discharging C8 10 µF (fast). The known 'attack mod' changes R13 150 kΩ; not modelled as a control. Stored only

controls.label: Release
controls.note: No release control: C8 10 µF recharges through R13 150 kΩ (τ = 1.5 s). Stored only

controls.label: Threshold
controls.note: No threshold control (the loop has no threshold: the Sensitivity rheostat sets the maximum IABC). Stored only

controls.label: Sidechain
controls.note: No external sidechain input. Stored only

controls.label: Balance trim (internal)
controls.note: 2 kΩ trimmer between the OTA inputs; its wiper takes the bias current from R5 470 kΩ. ElectroSmash: 'adjusted to the middle position'. Sets the control-feedthrough null

parts.label: 9 V battery
parts.note: D3 1N4148 reverse-polarity diode across the battery (ElectroSmash) is reverse biased in normal use and omitted. No DC jack on the script-era unit

parts.label: Battery internal resistance
parts.note: unverified: not a schematic part (typical fresh 9 V carbon-zinc). The original has no supply reservoir (Keen marks the 10 µF as 'not in the original'; ElectroSmash agrees)

parts.label: Vb divider (bottom)
parts.note: unverified: 27 kΩ per Keen's D-Comp and Kröning et al. (Vbias 2.93 V); ElectroSmash's BOM gives 22 kΩ (2.54 V). No bypass cap on the original (Keen), so Vb also carries the R8 signal current

parts.label: Q1 input follower
parts.note: 2N3904 per ElectroSmash and Kröning; Keen: original type unknown (2N5088 in his build); some units MPSA14

parts.label: U1 CA3080
parts.note: Pins: out 6, + 3, − 2, IABC 5, V− 4 (ground), V+ 7 (+9 V)

parts.label: OTA load roll-off
parts.note: unverified: 1 nF per ElectroSmash and Kröning et al.; Keen's D-Comp list gives 0.01 µF. A common mod lowers or removes it

parts.label: Sensitivity
parts.note: unverified taper: linear per Keen ('500K lin'); some units carry a 470 kΩ C-taper (freestompboxes). Rheostat on the wiper-to-pin-3 segment: R = 500k·(1 − t(x))
